faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Trichy recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Project Associate and Project Assistant positions at NIT Trichy is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate and Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 post for Project Associate and 1 post for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate?
faq.answer: For the Project Associate position, candidates need to have an M.E./M.Tech./M.Plan or equivalent degree in Civil Engineering, or a B.E./B.Tech./B.Arch/B.Plan or equivalent degree in Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The required qualification for the Project Assistant role is a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology or a relevant Degree with First Class in Civil Engineering or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for all posts is 35 years as of the closing date of the advertisement. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any age relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST candidates are eligible for a 5-year age relaxation, and OBC candidates are eligible for a 3-year age relaxation.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Project Associate?
faq.answer: The Project Associate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test and/or Interview.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the NIT Trichy recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to fill out the application form and upload it along with supporting documents via the provided Google Form link before the last date.
